scope: Read-only current frozen candidate review; no live runtime evidence inspected and no source edits.

findings.fact: Existing non-pickable RealityView still resets camera on a targeted contact tap before optional callback. Image branch has drag/magnify only, no reset action.
findings.implication: If adopted, preserve an explicit accessible reset interaction or document/approve changed workout orbit UX; this trial cannot establish interaction equivalence.

findings.fact: Frame retains model/ODR lease/renderer/texture until completion. Completion closure retains coordinator. No timeout/cancellation/failure callback policy exists; if updateAndRender throws after frame assignment, fail() leaves frame set. If callback never arrives, latest pending work cannot drain and disappeared coordinator resources may remain retained.
findings.limit: This is a source-level unhandled completion/error path, not evidence that RealityRenderer actually omits callbacks in current runs.

findings.fact: Static environment preparation caches a failed Task permanently. Subsequent coordinator/view creation reawaits the same failure; only process restart resets it.
findings.implication: Production retry/error policy needs an explicit decision and targeted failure test.

findings.fact: Uniform-white environment is an intentional lighting adaptation. Every semantic/size/orbit request immediately clears visible image; pending work yields transparent content with no loading indication. Initial environment setup and rapid animated resizing can extend blank intervals.
findings.limit: No appearance equivalence or actual latency inferred; runtime whole-image coverage must assess visibility and orientation.

confirmedDesignProperties.fact: MainActor serial state; one in-flight Frame and one replaceable latest pending Request. New revision clears old image immediately; completion publishes only when active and exact current revision. Stale completion releases frame then drains newest pending.
Disappear invalidates revision, clears pending/image, rejects late publication. Setup returning while inactive does not attach model. Reappearance can resubmit same input because active was false.

StateObject scoped to model identity; same model root/camera/selection/highlight authoring reused. Orbit clamps match existing scene. No scene mutations for newer request until older frame completion.

Flag forwarded only through workout portrait/landscape; DEBUG env false in release. Interactive onContactTap maps retain original RealityView and picking. Actual no-callback workout host is image branch; Train remains original.

focusedTestsIfRuntimePasses: Synchronous fake completion driver: submit active A, preview B, active C before A completes; one in-flight, stale A not published, only C drains/publishes, repeated identical submit creates no render.
Submit clear contacts and nil pose after highlighted/posed frame; exact latest image revision corresponds to restored materials/canonical pose; no stale colored image during pending work.

Disappear during setup and GPU work, then reappear or replace model identity: no old publication; eventual resource/ODR release after completion; setup failure and synchronous render throw release ownership safely.
Zero-size then positive resize and scale change: no invalid allocation, correct dimensions/orientation, newest viewport wins; unchanged inputs remain idle.
Orbit/zoom survives mode-only changes, clamp bounds match scene, return/reset behavior verified; interactive contact-tap routes remain original physical picking.

Whole fresh app normal workout with real hands, portrait/landscape, early readiness and both active/preview directions; actual rendered frame verdict rather than CPU material values. Include a suspended/posed board before generalizing past fixed Evo.
limits: No production recommendation before actual trial verdict.
Private candidate types currently lack injectable render completion; deterministic request tests would need a narrow test seam, not a broad renderer rewrite.
